title: Weighting-Based Strategies for Classification: Analysis and Local Peak Dynamics with CART Trees
abstract: arXiv:2610.18037v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular learning tasks often suffer from class imbalance, which is often addressed via weighting-based strategies. In this work, we compare the naive approach (unweighted) with the weighting-based rebalancing strategies. Somewhat surprisingly, we demonstrate that, asymptotically, as the predictor complexity increases with sample size, weighting strategies yield predictive performance identical to unweighted approaches across all evaluation metrics, up to a shift in the final threshold. To go beyond, we theoretically study the estimation of a linear regression function through weighted and unweighted CART trees with limited depths. In this setting, we prove that the points in the PR space for both strategies are distributed along the same curve, thus illustrating the similar nonasymptotic performance of the two strategies. Then, we numerically identify more complex synthetic settings where performance gaps, evaluated via fixed classifier

translated_title: 基于加权的分类策略：基于CART树的分析与局部峰值动态研究
translated_abstract: 表格学习任务常常受到类别不平衡问题的困扰，这一问题通常通过基于加权的策略来解决。在这项工作中，我们比较了朴素方法（不加权）与基于加权的再平衡策略。有些令人惊讶的是，我们证明了在渐近意义下，随着预测器复杂度随样本量增加，加权策略在所有评估指标上都能取得与不加权方法相同的预测性能，仅存在最终阈值的偏移。为了进一步深入研究，我们从理论上研究了通过有限深度的加权与不加权CART树对线性回归函数的估计问题。在这一设定中，我们证明了两种策略在PR空间（精确率-召回率空间）中的点分布在同一条曲线上，从而说明两种策略具有相似的非渐近性能。随后，我们通过数值实验识别出更复杂的合成设置，其中通过固定分类器评估的性能差距……
tldr: 该论文从理论和实验上证明，在类别不平衡分类任务中，加权策略与不加权策略的预测性能本质上相同——渐近情况下两者仅相差一个阈值偏移，非渐近情况下二者在PR空间中沿同一曲线分布。
en_tdlr: This paper theoretically and empirically demonstrates that weighting-based and unweighted strategies achieve essentially identical predictive performance for class-imbalanced classification: asymptotically they differ only by a threshold shift, and non-asymptotically their points lie along the same curve in PR space.
